tools.name: scrapfly_products_and_pricing
tools.description: Get the catalog of Scrapfly products (Web Scraping API, Cloud Browser, Crawler API, Extraction API, Screenshot API, Proxy Saver) with what each does, when to recommend it, its key features and docs entrypoint, plus the current pricing plans. Use this to advise a customer on which product fits their use case and what it costs.

tools.name: scrapfly_sdks_and_install
tools.description: List the official Scrapfly SDKs (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Rust) with their GitHub repository, git clone command, package registry name, one-line install command, and docs link. Use this to tell a customer which SDK to use for their language and exactly how to install or clone it.

tools.name: search_scrapfly_documentation
tools.description: Search the Scrapfly documentation for a query and return the most relevant pages (title, URL, and a content snippet). Use this to answer how Scrapfly works, find API parameters, error codes (e.g. ERR::ASP::SHIELD_PROTECTION), SDK usage, and integration guides.

query.description: The natural-language or keyword search query.

product.description: Optional product filter. One of: web_scraping_api, cloud_browser, crawler_api, extraction_api, screenshot_api, proxy_saver, or an SDK tag (sdk-python, sdk-typescript, sdk-go, sdk-rust). Omit to search all products.
